rows.en: Helen!!
Sharivan!!
Kyaaaah!!
Defeat General Guiler, Gori Beast and all Fightlow Soldiers!
Defeat all of Makuu, Madou and Fuuma!
Bell Helen is defeated
Bell Helen or Den Iga is defeated
[HERO2]! Let's walk home together♥

…?

Oh, it's just you, [HERO4]…
Don't "oh, it's just you" me~ Geez, you're so cold!

We live right by each other and we're together 24/7…

At least while we're at school, I'd like a little breathing room!
Wha~t… [HERO2], do you hate me?

Like I said… it's not about liking or hating…

How do I put it… um… time to be by yourself, I guess? That's important, right? Stuff like that!
I don't get it…
Three years ago today… the two of them walked side by side down this road lined with falling cherry blossoms…

We don't have to go together… We're going to the same place anyway, right? We'll see each other later…

Ah…!

I doubt it, but… you haven't forgotten, have you? Today's Friday!

Huh…

Oh yeah… I forgot!! It's riding club day…

Geez… are you even serious about it?

That's why you failed the riding certification exam twice!
You don't have to put it like that… [HERO2], you meanie!
Satoru and the others are coming today too, right? It'd be bad to be late…
Ah…!

Gaaah…

Now what? What's wrong?
I forgot my riding gear…!

No way…!?

Didn't you keep it in your locker at school?
Yeah… but I took it home to get it dry-cleaned…

Whaaat…!?

What are you gonna do? Satoru and the others… they'll be here any minute.

I'll apologize to my big brother later…

So you go on ahead, [HERO2]! I'll stop by home first and then go…
O-okay… Be careful, okay? See you…
Sigh… I'm feeling so totally blue.
I told you over and over never to come here…
Fufufu… I just can't stop worrying about my test subjects, you see.

The kids are still at school! …!?

Surely… you're not planning to meet them in person?
And what if I am?

Th-that's not what we agreed!

The kids aren't to know about the clinical trials…

I never said I'd spill the secret, now did I?

But… the deadline we agreed on passed long ago!

Don't you dare tell me you've forgotten! Dr. Hinata…!

No… th-that's…

But… the Vol genome can't be decoded in so short a time! It's not as simple as Pavlov's dog!

You design autonomous thinking routines like artificial intelligence and pseudo-personalities, so you of all people should understand that much!

That's right…

And that's why… I wanted to see the subjects with my own eyes!

Test subjects 003 and 004 in particular…
[HERO4] and [HERO2]…?

Test subject 005 has already grown up exactly as we hoped!

So I thought it was about time I did a little tinkering with 003 and 004.

Tinkering?

What are you going to do?
Fufufu… That's not something you need to know, Dr. Hinata…!

Honestly, [HERO4]… she's got such a scatterbrained streak.

But, well… that's part of what makes her her…
Wh-what…!? What is this thing…!
Gikkyuiiin…

…!?

This smell…!? No way? Is it the same as me!? One of my kind? This thing…?
No… I don't think so…! This thing is no kin of mine!

It was all well and good that you discovered the parasitic cell Vol in the corpse of a creature washed up on the shore…

but who do you think made it possible to carry the clinical trials this far?
Well… that's…

We have applied the results of your research in all sorts of fields…

To begin with, we developed the prototype Gigant, a Roaring Steel combat droid incorporating Vol cells!

What!?

You intend to use my research as a tool for slaughter?

Hmph…

A bit late for that… You knew that perfectly well yourself!

Don't you dare say you didn't know! Your own son, test subject 005, is the ultimate bio-weapon… a tool for slaughter if ever there was one!
Th-that's…

Yes, yes… "This wasn't supposed to happen!" is what you want to say, right?

But it doesn't work that way!

…!?

S-Satoru…!

Fufufu…

This test subject 005 needs food! Good-quality Vol-cell EATERs…

For that, improving the mass-production Gigant is essential! And for that, we need the Vol genome decoded!

Are you fine with letting your son starve to death?
Satoru…
Test subject 005… How is that experiment going?

I picked two, Tatsuya Todo and Kaori Minoshima, and they've already been treated!

To test their power, I've sent them after test subject 004! Along with the prototype Gigant.

Treated? What do you mean!?

Satoru! What have you done? What on earth did you do to Tatsuya and Kaori!?
The same thing you did to us, old man!

…!?

What…!?

Satoru! Do you understand what you've done!? What kind of person are you! Why would you…

What's that…

I don't want to hear that from you, old man! You're no different! To me and [HERO4]… and even to [HERO2]…

No…

At least [HERO4] and [HERO2] are progressing smoothly, just as I predicted…

Growing smoothly into monsters… you mean?

Smoothly, my ass! Turning us into test subjects without asking!
"Satoru," my foot! Don't you call me by name like we're close!

…!?

It's you, isn't it? Atefarina, you did something to Satoru? You did something to his body, didn't you?

To the Vol… no, to the archaeal cells? That's why… Satoru's body started going berserk!

Fufufu… Sorry, but from here on, it's our clinical trial…

A pity, but… you have no right to know!
Damn you… I won't let you do as you please!
Oh my? And what do you plan to do about it, Dr. Hinata?

No way…!?

Is this a fire? Huh…? Wawawa… no, no way, this can't be!

Papaaa!! Grandpaaa!!

Where are you!? Answer me!! Papaaa…!!
[HERO4]!!
Grandpa!?
[HERO4], are you all right? Are you hurt?

Yeah… Grandpa, where's Papa?

Hey… where's Papa? Grandpa!!
It's no use! In flames like these, he can't be saved…

…!?

No! I don't want that! Nooo!!
Wait! [HERO4]! It's dangerous!!
Papaaa…!

Damn! She's not answering her phone! Something must've happened to [HERO4] too!

I have to hurry…

[HERO4]! Please be safe!
